title: THE YOUR STATS TITLES ARE WHOLE
why: Seen on the 4K YOUR STATS screenshot of 2026-10-08: four card titles on the Mainframe stats page were cut off with dots (NET LIFETIME EARNI..., TYPICAL RAID LENG..., AVERAGE CONTAINE..., AVERAGE KILLS PER ...). A title now wraps onto a second line, and every title keeps room for two so the numbers in a row stay level.
now: Every YOUR STATS card shows its whole title.
